title: Overlay for Tier List
description: A clean, performant in-game overlay for Slay the Spire 2 displaying card, relic, and Ancient choice tier badges, scores, and evaluations.
changeNote:
v1.0.0 Release:
- Full card, relic, and Ancient choice (Neow, Act 2, Act 3) tier overlay support.
- Support for custom text ratings (Map Dependent, Inconsistent, Always Amazing, Always Good).
- Compact glassmorphic pill design.
- Automated tier list synchronization & diff engine.
